parameters.help_en: The stable ID of the target knowledge base. You can obtain this ID by calling ListKnowledgeBases
parameters.help_zh: 目标知识库的稳定 ID，可通过 ListKnowledgeBases 获取
parameters.name: knowledge_base_id

schema.description_en: The successful response of the operation

Code.description_en: The business error code. This field is omitted when the request is successful. If the request fails, the common error response protocol applies
Code.description_zh: 业务错误代码。成功时可省略；失败遵循公共错误响应协议

Data.description_en: The public configuration information of the target knowledge base
Data.description_zh: 目标知识库的公共配置信息

AccessRole.description_en:
The read-only access role of the current caller for the knowledge base. Valid values:
OWNER: Owner.
ADMIN: Administrator.
VIEWER: Viewer
AccessRole.description_zh: 当前调用者对知识库的只读访问角色：OWNER 为负责人，ADMIN 为管理员，VIEWER 为查看者

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the knowledge base was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 知识库创建时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Description.description_en: The description of the knowledge base. This field can be empty if no description is set
Description.description_zh: 知识库的描述信息，未设置时可以为空
Description.example: 销售指标、订单及业务制度知识。

KnowledgeBaseId.description_en: The stable ID of the knowledge base. You can use this ID to limit the search scope
KnowledgeBaseId.description_zh: 知识库的稳定 ID，可用于限定检索范围

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the knowledge base was last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 知识库最近修改时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

Name.description_en: The name of the knowledge base

Owner.description_en: The DataWorks user ID of the knowledge base owner
Owner.description_zh: 知识库负责人的 DataWorks 用户 ID

Status.description_en: The public status of the knowledge base. Only normally visible knowledge bases are returned. The value is ACTIVE
Status.description_zh: 知识库公共状态。本列表仅返回正常可见知识库，值为 ACTIVE

Type.description_en:
The type of the knowledge base. Valid values:
PERSONAL: Personal knowledge base.
ENTERPRISE: Enterprise knowledge base
Type.description_zh: 知识库类型：PERSONAL 为个人知识库，ENTERPRISE 为企业知识库

Message.description_en: The human-readable description of the business error. This field is omitted when the request is successful. When troubleshooting a failure, also provide the RequestId
Message.description_zh: 业务错误的可读说明，成功时可省略。失败定位时请同时提供 RequestId

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
